codeReview.summary: The feature covers most of the requested Tools/Calculator restyling, but it still misses two contract-level requirements: the tools hub does not keep irrigation tools on the irrigation color token, and the LAI dual-result cards were shrunk below the required 24px emphasis size. The final Nutrients follow-up also hardcodes light-mode colors instead of routing through theme tokens.

issues.description: VAL-TOOLS-001 requires category-colored icon circles, but the irrigation tools are not actually using the irrigation token. `mad` is tagged with `categoryKey: 'tools.categories.irrigation'` while using `colors.spray[500]` at line 127, and `system-discharge` is also tagged as irrigation while using `colors.primary[500]` at line 136. That leaves the tools hub out of sync with the category palette defined for irrigation.

VAL-CALC-002 calls for 24px/700 values in both LAI result boxes, but both highlighted values use `fontSize: fontSize.xl` at lines 285 and 313. In `src/styles/theme.ts:274`, `fontSize.xl` resolves to 20, so the redesign does not meet the required 24px result emphasis for either the LAI or canopy-width tile.

The phosphorus and potassium rows hardcode `#D0A14A` and `#A56B4F` at lines 287-296 instead of using theme tokens. This matches the light-mode mock, but it bypasses the dark-mode accent/secondary variants described in `.factory/library/architecture.md` and makes the calculator harder to keep consistent with future token updates.
